cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen opens with header, five entry fields and key legend
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Operator is signed on and selects Card Add from the Main Menu, starting transaction `OROD`.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Card Add screen (transaction `OROD`)
2. Read the whole screen without typing anything
cases.expected: The screen is drawn fresh (erased): the header shows Tran `OROD`, Pgm `OCCARDA`, title `ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM`, and the current date/time. The five entry captions `Card Num :`, `Acct ID  :`, `Name     :`, `CVV      :`, `Expiry   :` are shown with empty green input areas, the key legend `ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear` is on the bottom line, and the message line shows `Enter new card details and press ENTER.`
cases.remark: UI §2.1 / map MCARDAA mapset MCARDA · 1000-SEND-INITIAL (SEND MAP ERASE); msg WS-M-PROMPT `Enter new card details and press ENTER.`

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Entry fields start empty and the cursor rests on Card Num
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen just opened (transaction `OROD`).
cases.steps: 1. Observe the entry fields and the cursor position on the freshly opened screen
cases.expected: All five entry areas (Card Num, Acct ID, Name, CVV, Expiry) are blank, the header date and time are populated from the current clock, and the cursor is positioned on the `Card Num :` field ready for input.
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL: LOW-VALUES to map, 8000-POPULATE-HEADER (ASKTIME/FORMATTIME), cursor `MOVE -1 TO CARDNUML`

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Only the five card fields accept input; header and message line are protected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen open (transaction `OROD`).
cases.steps:
1. Try to tab through every field on the screen
2. Attempt to type into the header and the message line
cases.expected: The cursor stops only on the five green entry fields (`Card Num :`, `Acct ID  :`, `Name     :`, `CVV      :`, `Expiry   :`); the header (Tran/Pgm/Date/Time/title) and the message line are display-only and cannot be typed into. There is no hidden or conditionally shown field — the single add mode presents the same layout throughout.
cases.remark: §2 item-states: CARDNUM/CDACCT/CDNAME/CDCVV/CDEXP UNPROT; TRNNAME/TITLE/CURDATE/PGMNAME/CURTIME/ERRMSG ASKIP (display-only)

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Entry field widths and colours match the map definition
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen open (transaction `OROD`).
cases.steps: 1. Inspect the on-screen width and colour of each entry field and caption
cases.expected: The entry areas accept up to Card Num = 16 characters, Acct ID = 11, Name = 50, CVV = 3, Expiry = 10, each shown in green; captions are blue, the title is yellow, the message line is red and the key legend is turquoise.
cases.remark: §2.1 map MCARDAA: CARDNUM 16 / CDACCT 11 / CDNAME 50 / CDCVV 3 / CDEXP 10; colours GREEN/BLUE/YELLOW/RED/TURQUOISE

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 cancels and returns to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen open (transaction `OROD`), some values may be typed.
cases.steps: 1. Press `PF3`
cases.expected: The add is cancelled without saving anything and control is handed to the Main Menu program `OCMENU`; the Card Add screen is left.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU (EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM WS-MENU-PGM `OCMENU`); linkage U18 downstream hand-off

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entered values and re-prompts
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen open with values typed in the entry fields.
cases.steps:
1. Type values into the entry fields
2. Press `PF4`
cases.data: Key = `PF4`; any typed values, e.g. Card Num `4000000000000010`
cases.expected: All entry fields are cleared to blank, the message line returns to `Enter new card details and press ENTER.` and the cursor returns to `Card Num :`; nothing is saved and the operator can start again.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (fresh map + WS-M-PROMPT)

cases.name: Cold start with no commarea shows a fresh add screen
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Transaction `OROD` is started directly (no communication area passed).
cases.steps: 1. Start transaction `OROD` with an empty communication area (first entry)
cases.expected: The program initialises its work area and shows the fresh Card Add screen with the prompt `Enter new card details and press ENTER.`, exactly as a normal open; the transaction then waits for the next key (pseudo-conversational return on `OROD`).
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN IF EIBCALEN=0 INITIALIZE ORION-COMMAREA → 1000-SEND-INITIAL; 9000-RETURN TRANSID WS-TRANID `OROD`

cases.name: After a successful add the screen redraws fresh for the next card
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. A valid new card has just been added (see IT_CARDADD_HAPPY_009).
cases.steps:
1. Complete a successful add of card `4000000000000010`
2. Observe the screen after processing
cases.data: Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `TEST CARDHOLDER`, CVV `321`, Expiry `2030-12-31`
cases.expected: The screen is redrawn fresh (entry fields blank, cursor on `Card Num :`) with the message line showing `Card issued successfully.`, so the operator can immediately key the next card; the transaction stays on `OROD`.
cases.remark: 2100-ADD-CARD success branch: 1000-SEND-INITIAL then WS-M-OK to ERRMSG + 8100-SEND-DATAONLY

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Add a valid new card against an existing account
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Account `00000000001` exists and is active; card `4000000000000010` is not yet on file.
cases.steps:
1. Open Card Add (transaction `OROD`)
2. Enter Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `TEST CARDHOLDER`, CVV `321`, Expiry `2030-12-31`
3. Press `ENTER`
cases.data: Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `TEST CARDHOLDER`, CVV `321`, Expiry `2030-12-31`
cases.expected: Every field passes its check, the account is confirmed on file and the card number is confirmed unused; the new card is created on the Card master and a cross-reference row links the card to its account; the message line shows `Card issued successfully.` and the screen redraws fresh.
cases.remark: §1.2 / 5000-VALIDATE-ALL clean → 3500-WRITE-CARD (CARDFILE C) + 3700-WRITE-XREF (XREFFILE C); msg WS-M-OK `Card issued successfully.`

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: A card can be added against an inactive account (no active-status gate)
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Account `00000000003` exists but is flagged inactive; card `4000000000000010` is unused.
cases.steps:
1. Open Card Add (transaction `OROD`)
2. Enter Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000003`, Name `INACTIVE ACCT CARD`, CVV `456`, Expiry `2029-06-30`
3. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The card is created and `Card issued successfully.` is shown: OCCARDA only checks that the account exists, not whether it is active, so the inactive status does not block the add.
cases.remark: 5060-VAL-ACCT-EXISTS tests only REC-FOUND (ignores AC-ACTIVE-STATUS); documents the no-active-gate behaviour

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: A second card can be added to an account that already owns one
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Account `00000000001` already owns card `4000000000000001`; card `4000000000000011` is unused.
cases.steps:
1. Open Card Add (transaction `OROD`)
2. Enter Card Num `4000000000000011`, Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `SECOND CARD`, CVV `654`, Expiry `2031-01-31`
3. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The second card is created and `Card issued successfully.` is shown: uniqueness is enforced on the card number only, so an account may own more than one card.
cases.remark: 5070-VAL-CARD-UNIQUE keys on CD-NUM only (no per-account card count); 3500-WRITE-CARD/3700-WRITE-XREF

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: New card is stored active with the embossed name as typed
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. A valid add has just been performed (card `4000000000000010`).
cases.steps:
1. Add card `4000000000000010` with Name `TEST CARDHOLDER`
2. Inspect the stored card record
cases.data: Name `TEST CARDHOLDER`, active flag set by the program
cases.expected: The stored card keeps the embossed name exactly as typed (`TEST CARDHOLDER`) and its active status is set to `Y` by the program (the operator does not enter it); the CVV and expiry are stored as keyed.
cases.remark: 3500-WRITE-CARD: MOVE 'Y' TO CD-ACTIVE-STATUS; CD-EMBOSSED-NAME from CDNAMEI

cases.name: Card master record is written with all entered columns
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Valid entry ready (card `4000000000000010`).
cases.steps:
1. Add card `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `TEST CARDHOLDER`, CVV `321`, Expiry `2030-12-31`
2. Read back the new Card master row
cases.expected: A Card master row is created with number `4000000000000010`, account `00000000001`, CVV `321`, embossed name `TEST CARDHOLDER`, expiry `2030-12-31` and active status `Y`; the row is keyed by the card number.
cases.remark: §5 CARDFILE(C); 3500-WRITE-CARD → CD-NUM/CD-ACCT-ID/CD-CVV/CD-EMBOSSED-NAME/CD-EXPIRY-DATE/CD-ACTIVE-STATUS (copybook RCARD)

cases.name: Cross-reference record links the new card to its account
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Valid entry ready (card `4000000000000010`, account `00000000001`).
cases.steps:
1. Add card `4000000000000010` against account `00000000001`
2. Read back the new cross-reference row
cases.expected: A cross-reference row is created holding the card number `4000000000000010`, the account `00000000001` and the customer id recovered from the account cross-reference stub (defaulting to `000000000` when the stub is absent).
cases.remark: §5 XREFFILE(C); 3700-WRITE-XREF → XR-CARD-NUM/XR-ACCT-ID/XR-CUST-ID; cust from 3200-READ-STUB (stub keyed by account id, usually misses → 0)

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Re-adding the same card number is blocked, leaving no duplicate
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card `4000000000000010` was just added successfully.
cases.steps:
1. Add card `4000000000000010` again with the same or different other fields
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The second attempt is rejected with `Card number already exists.` and no second row is created; re-running the same add is idempotent — the Card master keeps a single row for `4000000000000010`.
cases.remark: 5070-VAL-CARD-UNIQUE READ CARDFILE finds the row → WS-M-CARD-DUP; write suppressed (idempotence)

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: Expiry date is validated by the date-utility subroutine
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen open; other fields carry accepted values (Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `TEST CARDHOLDER`, CVV `321`).
cases.steps:
1. Enter a well-formed expiry `2030-12-31` with the other fields set to the accepted values above
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The date-utility subroutine `OUDATE` is called to validate the expiry; for `2030-12-31` it returns status `00` (accepted) and processing continues to the write. An ill-formed date would be rejected via the same subroutine (see UT_CARDADD_ABNORMAL_005).
cases.remark: 5050-VAL-EXPIRY: CALL 'OUDATE' USING KDATE-PARM, KD-FUNC 'VALD'; KD-STATUS '00'=valid, '99'=invalid (design §1.1 shows LINK; source uses static CALL)

cases.name: Card number containing letters is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen open (transaction `OROD`).
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num `4000ABCD00000010` (contains letters), other fields valid
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The entry is refused before any lookup or write: the message line shows `Card number must be sixteen digits.`, the screen is kept with the typed values and the cursor returns to `Card Num :`.
cases.remark: 5010-VAL-CARD → 6000-PARSE-NUM sets WS-INVALID on non-digit; WS-M-CARD-REQ `Card number must be sixteen digits.`; SEND DATAONLY, no write

cases.name: Non-numeric account id is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen open; Card Num valid (`4000000000000010`).
cases.steps:
1. Enter Acct ID `00A0000001` (contains a letter)
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The message line shows `Account id must be numeric.`, the screen is kept and nothing is written; the same message is raised when the account id is left blank (no digits parsed).
cases.remark: 5020-VAL-ACCT → 6000-PARSE-NUM non-digit / digits=0 → WS-INVALID; WS-M-ACCT-NUM `Account id must be numeric.`

cases.name: Blank embossed name is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Num `4000000000000010` and Acct ID `00000000001` are accepted values; Name left blank.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`, leave Name blank, CVV `321`, Expiry `2030-12-31`
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The message line shows `Embossed name is required.`, the screen is kept with the typed values and nothing is written.
cases.remark: 5030-VAL-NAME: CDNAMEI = SPACES/LOW-VALUES → WS-INVALID; WS-M-NAME-REQ `Embossed name is required.`

cases.name: Non-numeric CVV is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001` and Name `TEST CARDHOLDER` are accepted values.
cases.steps:
1. Enter CVV `1A2` (contains a letter), other fields set to the accepted values above
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The message line shows `CVV must be three numeric digits.`, the screen is kept and nothing is written.
cases.remark: 5040-VAL-CVV → 6000-PARSE-NUM non-digit / digits≠3 → WS-INVALID; WS-M-CVV-NUM `CVV must be three numeric digits.`

cases.name: Ill-formed expiry date is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `TEST CARDHOLDER` and CVV `321` are accepted values.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Expiry `2030-13-01` (month out of range), other fields set to the accepted values above
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The date utility returns an invalid status, so the card is NOT created; the message line reports that the expiry date is invalid and must be entered as an ISO date such as `2030-12-31`, and the cursor returns to the entry fields.
cases.remark: 5050-VAL-EXPIRY: OUDATE 'VALD' KD-STATUS `99` (month>12) → WS-M-EXP-BAD `Expiry date invalid, use YYYY-MM-DD.`

cases.name: Account not on file is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Account `00000000099` is not on the account master.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000099`, Name `TEST CARDHOLDER`, CVV `321`, Expiry `2030-12-31`
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: All field-format checks pass but the account lookup finds nothing, so the message line shows `Account does not exist.` and no card is created.
cases.remark: 5060-VAL-ACCT-EXISTS → 3000-READ-ACCT NOTFND → REC-NOT-FOUND → WS-M-ACCT-NF `Account does not exist.`

cases.name: Duplicate card number is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card `4000000000000001` already exists on the card master.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num `4000000000000001` (already on file), Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `DUP CARD`, CVV `321`, Expiry `2030-12-31`
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The card-uniqueness check finds the existing card, so the message line shows `Card number already exists.` and no new card is created. (The same message is raised if a concurrent write hits a duplicate at commit — see remark.)
cases.remark: 5070-VAL-CARD-UNIQUE READ CARDFILE found → WS-M-CARD-DUP; second trigger 3500-WRITE-CARD DUPREC (concurrency race, same message) — see U12

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported key is rejected with an invalid-key message
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen open (transaction `OROD`).
cases.steps:
1. Press an unsupported key such as `PF1` or `PF5`
2. Read the message line
cases.expected: The key is refused, the typed values are preserved and the message line shows `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.`; the screen stays on Card Add.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN OTHER → WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY (copybook WMSG) `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.`; 8100-SEND-DATAONLY

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A card-file write failure reports a write error
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Entry is complete and accepted (Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`) but the Card master file returns a non-recoverable write response (e.g. file disabled / out of space) that is neither success nor duplicate.
cases.steps:
1. Enter a valid new card `4000000000000010` with account `00000000001`
2. Press `ENTER` while the card file cannot be written
cases.data: Card file write response = other-than-normal (simulated), Card Num `4000000000000010`
cases.expected: Validation passes but the create fails, so the message line shows `Error writing the card file.`, the cursor returns to `Card Num :` and no cross-reference is written.
cases.remark: 3500-WRITE-CARD EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN OTHER → WS-M-WRITE-ERR `Error writing the card file.`; WS-WRITE-BAD stops the xref write

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Cross-reference write failure leaves the card written with a warning
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Entry is complete and accepted (Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`); the card write succeeds but the cross-reference file returns a non-recoverable write response.
cases.steps:
1. Add a valid new card `4000000000000010`
2. Press `ENTER` while the cross-reference file cannot be written
cases.expected: The card is created on the Card master but the link write fails, so the message line shows `Card written; cross-ref write failed.`; this is a partial-commit state (card present, cross-reference missing) that operations must reconcile.
cases.remark: 3700-WRITE-XREF EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN OTHER → WS-M-XREF-ERR `Card written; cross-ref write failed.`; card already written by 3500 (U11 partial commit)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unrecoverable file error during lookup ends the task
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. The account or card lookup returns a response that is neither normal nor not-found (e.g. file closed / I/O error).
cases.steps:
1. Enter a valid card and account
2. Press `ENTER` while the account (or card) file returns an unrecoverable response
cases.expected: The transaction abends gracefully (ABEND path): a full-screen text `OCCARDA: unrecoverable file error. Contact support.` is shown and the task ends without writing anything.
cases.remark: 3000-READ-ACCT / 3100-READ-CARD EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN OTHER → 9500-ABEND-RTN (SEND TEXT + EXEC CICS RETURN, task ends)

cases.name: Card number of 15 digits (one short of sixteen) is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Add screen open (transaction `OROD`).
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num `400000000000001` (15 digits), other fields valid
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.data: Card Num `400000000000001` (15 digits); the accepted count is exactly 16
cases.expected: The card is refused with `Card number must be sixteen digits.`; a full 16-digit number such as `4000000000000010` is the smallest accepted value (the field caps entry at 16, so 17 cannot be keyed).
cases.remark: 5010-VAL-CARD WS-NC-DIGITS≠16 → WS-M-CARD-REQ; field width 16 (map CARDNUM) caps the upper side

cases.name: Account id keyed without leading zeros is zero-extended and matched
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Account `00000000001` exists; card `4000000000000010` unused.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Acct ID `1` (single digit, no leading zeros), Card Num `4000000000000010`, other fields valid
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.data: Acct ID keyed as `1` → interpreted as `00000000001`
cases.expected: The numeric parser reads the single digit, zero-extends it to `00000000001` and finds the account, so the add succeeds with `Card issued successfully.`; the lower boundary of the account field (one digit) is accepted.
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-NUM accumulates WS-NC-VALUE (digits=1) → WS-NEW-ACCT `00000000001`; editing logic U9 (numeric parse ignores blanks, right-justifies value)

cases.name: Account id of the full 11 digits is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Account `00000000005` exists; card `4000000000000010` unused.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Acct ID `00000000005` (full 11 digits), Card Num `4000000000000010`, other fields valid
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.data: Acct ID `00000000005` (11 digits — the field maximum)
cases.expected: The 11-digit account is within the allowed width, the account is found and the add succeeds with `Card issued successfully.`; the field caps entry at 11, so a 12th digit cannot be keyed.
cases.remark: 5020-VAL-ACCT allows WS-NC-DIGITS up to 11 (>11 → WS-M-ACCT-NUM); map CDACCT width 11 caps the upper side

cases.name: CVV of 2 digits (one short of three) is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001` and Name `TEST CARDHOLDER` are accepted values.
cases.steps:
1. Enter CVV `12` (2 digits), other fields set to the accepted values above
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.data: CVV `12` (2 digits); the accepted count is exactly 3
cases.expected: The CVV is refused with `CVV must be three numeric digits.`; exactly 3 digits such as `321` is accepted and the field caps entry at 3, so a 4th digit cannot be keyed.
cases.remark: 5040-VAL-CVV WS-NC-DIGITS≠3 → WS-M-CVV-NUM; map CDCVV width 3 caps the upper side

cases.name: Embossed name of the full 50 characters is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Num `4000000000000010` unused; account `00000000001` exists.
cases.steps:
1. Enter a 50-character Name `ABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJABCDEFGHIJ`, other fields valid
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The 50-character name fills the field and the add succeeds with `Card issued successfully.`; the stored embossed name holds all 50 characters and the field caps entry at 50.
cases.remark: 5030-VAL-NAME only rejects blank; map CDNAME width 50 = CD-EMBOSSED-NAME PIC X(50) upper bound

cases.name: Expiry month 13 is rejected, month 12 accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `TEST CARDHOLDER` and CVV `321` are accepted values.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Expiry `2030-13-31` (month 13), other fields set to the accepted values above
2. Press `ENTER`
3. Retry with Expiry `2030-12-31` (month 12)
cases.expected: Month 13 is out of range, so the card is not created and the expiry-invalid message is shown (ISO date such as `2030-12-31` required); with month 12 the date passes and the add succeeds.
cases.remark: OUDATE 2000-VALIDATE: WS-M<1 OR >12 → KD-STATUS `99`; msg WS-M-EXP-BAD `Expiry date invalid, use YYYY-MM-DD.`

cases.name: Expiry day beyond the month length is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Num `4000000000000010`, Acct ID `00000000001`, Name `TEST CARDHOLDER` and CVV `321` are accepted values.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Expiry `2030-04-31` (April has 30 days), other fields set to the accepted values above
2. Press `ENTER`
3. Retry with Expiry `2030-04-30`
cases.data: Expiry `2030-04-31` (rejected) vs `2030-04-30` (accepted); day `32` is always rejected
cases.expected: Day 31 in a 30-day month is beyond the month length, so the card is not created and the expiry-invalid message is shown (ISO date such as `2030-04-30` required); day 30 for April passes and the add succeeds. A day of `32` is rejected in every month.
cases.remark: OUDATE 2000-VALIDATE: WS-DIM=30 for month 4/6/9/11; WS-D>WS-DIM → KD-STATUS `99`; WS-M-EXP-BAD

cases.name: Expiry of 29 February is accepted even in a non-leap year
cases.precondition: F-STD loaded. Card Num `4000000000000010` unused; account `00000000001` exists.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Expiry `2027-02-29` (2027 is not a leap year), other fields valid
2. Press `ENTER`
cases.expected: The date utility allows up to day 29 for February without a leap-year test, so `2027-02-29` is accepted and the add succeeds with `Card issued successfully.`; a February day of `30` would be rejected. (Documents the known no-leap-year-check behaviour.)
cases.remark: OUDATE 2000-VALIDATE WHEN 2 MOVE 29 TO WS-DIM (no leap-year branch) → 2027-02-29 KD-STATUS `00`; 2027-02-30 → `99`
